findings.claim: The assessment contradicts the carried-forward blocker that the producer-model guard is not live until the stale plugin caches are regenerated.
findings.evidence: Goals say: "`bash scripts/update-skill-pack.sh --force` — plugin caches are stale (6 drift findings). The producer-model guard is not live in any installed copy until this runs". Assessment says: "The producer≠judge rule and `kbd_require_producer_model` fail-closed guard are live."
findings.suggested_fix: Assess the cache-drift blocker explicitly and state that producer≠judge enforcement is not available to installed skills until `scripts/update-skill-pack.sh --force` is run and generated artifacts are committed.

findings.claim: The assessment omits the required prerequisite assessment for the two blockers carried in the goals.
findings.evidence: Goals list "Blockers to clear first": "Commit the previous phase — 150 changed paths" and "`bash scripts/update-skill-pack.sh --force` — plugin caches are stale". The assessment's goal-by-goal table covers only goals 1–7 and contains no assessment of whether the previous phase is committed or whether generated/plugin caches are still stale.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a blocker section that verifies the current state of the previous-phase commit and plugin-cache drift, and marks downstream ideation work blocked if either remains unresolved.

findings.claim: The assessment introduces a large mobile/P2P/KnowMe scope that is not present in the packet goals.
findings.evidence: Packet goals list seven ideation-and-decision-tool goals and do not mention mobile, P2P, Universal Agent Runtime, or KnowMe. The assessment states: "Scope extension: this assessment covers the seven seeded goals plus two areas the user added at invocation: (a) running these skills on mobile inside the Universal Agent Runtime, with KnowMe as the reference container; (b) P2P/remote execution" and later requires a "Deliverable: `docs/prometheus-skills-integration.md` in `know-me-system`".
findings.suggested_fix: Either add these mobile/P2P/KnowMe objectives to the formal goals packet or move them to a separate future-phase note so the next stage does not plan unapproved scope.

findings.claim: The KnowMe codebase claims are unsupported by the provided repository file tree.
findings.evidence: Assessment says: "Verified in `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/know-me/know-me-system`" and cites assets such as `knowme_plugin_host`, `gen_ui_ffi`, and `docs/knowme-builder-extensibility-spec.md`. The provided `file_tree` is for the current repository and contains no `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/know-me/know-me-system`, no `knowme_plugin_host`, and no `gen_ui_ffi`.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not treat external KnowMe inventory as verified in this assessment unless the packet includes that repository tree or prior handoff evidence; otherwise mark it as external research requiring validation.

findings.claim: Several concrete substrate claims rely on files not present in the supplied file tree.
findings.evidence: Assessment claims: "`dispatch-judge.sh` records all three values; `build-review-packet.sh` has `--mode skill|agent`" and "`detect-surface-tier.sh` is the single tier-logic site." The provided `file_tree` lists `scripts/` contents but does not include `dispatch-judge.sh`, `build-review-packet.sh`, or `detect-surface-tier.sh`, and contains no visible `ui-surface` path.
findings.suggested_fix: Cite actual paths present in the packet or downgrade these to unverified assumptions that analyze/plan must confirm before depending on them.
